findings.description: The method `void takeDamage(int damage)` subtracts damage from health without checking for underflow.
The `lastCastTime` and `lastDamageTime` are initialized to `-duration`, which may not be meaningful and could cause logic errors if negative time is not handled properly.
Comparisons using floating point arithmetic (with epsilon) can be error-prone and may lead to logic errors.
There is no input validation for the initial health or ability parameters.
If the dummy’s health is set to a very large value, the loop could run for a very long time, causing a denial of service.
